title: AIAS Enterprise Knowledge Graph
purpose: Materialize the persistent, attributable and queryable golden thread for all AIAS enterprise knowledge.
scope: Typed nodes and edges, stable identity, versions, temporal metadata, atomic persistence, traversal, impact analysis, controlled inference and AMIR ingestion.

requirements.title: Canonical schema
requirements.statement: Nodes and edges shall use stable typed identities, versions and source provenance.
requirements.rationale: Keep enterprise knowledge attributable and interoperable.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Durable integrity
requirements.statement: Persistence shall be atomic and reject identity conflicts and unknown endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Graph queries
requirements.statement: EKG shall expose adjacency, directed paths and transitive impact.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Controlled inference
requirements.statement: Only explicitly approved rules may infer edges and every result shall retain supporting provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: The complete AMIR inventory and dependency network shall import through EKG.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: EKG shall include tests, documentation, installer, manifest, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
